test.create_query: CREATE TABLE topk_stats_parts ( p UInt16, id UInt64, ts UInt64, val Nullable(Int64), tag UInt32, payload String ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, auto_statistics_types = 'basic', add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 0, parts_to_throw_insert = 1000, parts_to_delay_insert = 1000
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO topk_stats_parts SELECT intDiv(number, 524288) AS p, sipHash64(number) AS id, ((intDiv(number, 524288) * 17 + 13) % 50) * 1000000 + (number % 524288) AS ts, if(intDiv(number, 524288) = 10, NULL, toInt64(((intDiv(number, 524288) * 17 + 13) % 50) * 1000000 + (number % 524288))) AS val, number % 100 AS tag, concat('row_', toString(number), '_', repeat('x', 32)) AS payload FROM numbers(26214400) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 100, max_block_size = 524288, min_insert_block_size_rows = 524288, max_insert_block_size = 524288, max_insert_threads = 1, max_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT ts, payload FROM topk_stats_parts ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT ts, payload FROM topk_stats_parts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT val, payload FROM topk_stats_parts ORDER BY val ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT val, payload FROM topk_stats_parts ORDER BY val DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT ts, payload FROM topk_stats_parts WHERE tag = 7 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT ts, payload FROM topk_stats_parts WHERE tag = 7 ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
